analysis:
CHANGELOG.md only: base units 8/9 are unchanged historical text (lines 1311-1801). Head unit 10 (lines 1-222) holds the new Unreleased entries. These are documentation of behavior, not code, so there is no direct security regression in this PR. Claims for the next pass to check against the source diffs elsewhere in the PR:
- Provider cache storage controls (head line 14) relate to T-041 and TB-007: encrypted external volumes with pinned UUID, rolling-day write ledger kept on the Mac, no fallback to internal disk. This matches the canonical T-041 mitigation text, but the code (CacheVolume/CacheStorage) is not in this batch.
- Member-only automatic security clearance (line 18): scan-only merge clearance is limited to verified Layr-Labs members, with a separate read-only membership token. This is review-control or CI scope, outside the runtime threat model.
- Autopilot floor (lines 40-50) relates to T-060: payments default off, a separately funded pool, admin funding and baseline-repair endpoints, a Nov 7 2026 end date, and consent evidence. Check admin authorization, replay and idempotency in the code.
- Machine-scoped Autopilot (lines 56-61), KV admission, and the Bedrock/OpenRouter budget (line 75) were not reviewed beyond the changelog text.
- Soft-delete mutation gate defaults false (line 129) and account erasure (T-059, lines 135-153): the changelog says new erasure confirmations are blocked by default. Verify that the code matches.
- Logs no longer carry PII (line 161), consistent with T-058.
No source for these features was supplied. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety, so deeper review of the code diffs is warranted if they are in the PR.
